text:
elaine: Heads-up — saw a small cluster of SSE clients in EU region that go silent for ~20s then reconnect and we get duplicate billing traces. Dashboard shows session linger > ttl.
jurgen: Repro steps?
elaine: Trigger: long-running streaming prompt with intermittent 204 keepalive responses from proxy. Clients do not send resume token on reconnect.
sam: Any errors on the runtime side? stack traces?
jurgen: Nothing obvious in runtime logs. We see connection close -> client reconnect -> new session created. No resume id in auth headers.
kevin: Could be proxy returning 204 to keep socket open; client treats that as EOF sometimes. Which proxy version?
elaine: Proxy=proxy:v2.8.3; edge LB=alb-us-eu-01. Observability shows "linger_ms" metric spikes to ~25k.
observability-bot: New metric spike alert: sse.session_linger > 15s (4 occurrences in last 2h).
jurgen: Do we attach keepalive frames? We recently changed how proxy sends 204 vs pingback.
kevin: I remember a patch that switched to chunked-less 204 in PR #424. Might be related.
elaine: Repro locally: start a stream, then send intermittent HTTP/1.1 204 from proxy. Client (browser) fires reconnect and opens a clean WebSocket, no resume sent.
sam: Are clients misinterpreting 204 as terminal close? spec says 204 with no body is valid keepalive, but some clients treat it like an end-of-stream.
jurgen: True. Some of our SDKs treat an isolated 204 chunk as last event. We need to ensure we send an explicit ping event instead of raw 204 for streaming.
kevin: For immediate mitigation: add a tracer metric to console showing last-event-id presence and resume header per session. Then we can correlate duplicate billing with missing resume id.
elaine: Agree. Console needs a quick dashboard: per-route, percent of reconnects with resume token.
observability-bot: Created ticket OBS-1123 with link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OBS-1123
jurgen: I'll add a temporary proxy feature flag that toggles 204->sse-ping conversion. If turned on, proxy emits "event: ping\ndata: {\"keepalive\":true}\n\n" instead of 204.
kevin: Nice. Also need to ensure sticky routing metadata survives the ping->response roundtrip. We lost tenant cookie on some paths.
elaine: UX/console ask: show a timeline for a single session: events, 204s observed, resume-id seen, billing token. That will help PMs and SREs.
sam: On call playbook: if we see duplicate billing, run quick query:
```
SELECT session_id, resume_present, count(*) FROM sse_sessions WHERE time > now()-1h GROUP BY resume_present
```
kevin: Dev plan:
- short (now): add console metric + OBS alert (jurgen)
- short (now): proxy flag that converts 204 to SSE ping (jurgen)
- med: SDK defensive change to persist last-event-id and always attempt resume (kevin)
- med: dashboard timeline view (elaine + console team)
- long: audit PR#424 behavior and revert if needed (team)
elaine: Who can own rollout plan for the proxy flag? We want gradual canary to EU edge then global.
jurgen: I'll own canary. Will add deploy-bot annotation for canary groups.
deploy-bot: Canary campaign started: proxy-v2.8.4-flag -> eu-edge-20% (1751240200).
kevin: For telemetry: add tag "reconnect_resume_missing" to any reconnect event without resume header.
observability-bot: Metric created: sse.reconnect_resume_missing.count.
sam: Quick question: does billing de-dupe rely on resume ids or on token/session timestamp?
elaine: De-dupe today uses session_id + last_event_idx. No resume => new session => new bill.
jurgen: Edge case: client reconnects ultra-fast (<200ms) and we may get two in-flight resume attempts; ensure idempotency.
kevin: We'll add short debounce on console and runtime to coalesce attempts within 1s.
elaine: Action items agreed. I'll open a small runbook PR documenting how ops should respond and where the dashboard is.
sam: If the canary shows reduced duplicate billing, escalate to revert plan for PR#424.
kevin: Also ping SDK owners to push hotfix to persist last-event-id across reconnects.
elaine: Thanks everyone. I'll post updates here as we see canary results. :thumbsup:
jurgen: FYI — I'll attach a small packet capture snippet in the ticket. Example:
```
tcpdump -i eth0 -w /tmp/sse-eu.pcap 'tcp port 443'
```
observability-bot: OBS-1123 updated with logs and pcap (1751241800).
elaine: Closing loop: if anyone hits the dashboard, tag "reconnect-investigation" in threads.
kevin: I'll follow up with SDK PR today.
sam: Oncall will monitor the alert for 6h.
elaine: End of thread for now.
